svg.title: OCR TRILOGY
svg.desc: OCR trilogy: one Tesseract OCR engine shipped three ways. 2020 tesseract-ocr: FastAPI on Heroku. 2021 tesseract-flask: Flask-RESTX image on Docker Hub. 2022 tesseract-pillow: Flask web UI with Heroku and Azure continuous deployment. A scan beam reads a pixel bitmap and Tesseract returns the text. Tesseract, FastAPI, Flask-RESTX, Docker.

text.tspan: Same idea as my Humana OCR services.
